integrity: The infinite theorem rests on the complete combinatorial proof; finite executable enumerations are supporting checks, not proof of universal quantifiers. Prior general forest convergence and the existence-of-a-short-path result are acknowledged.
limitations: Path acceptability graph; fixed strict neighbor preferences and unmatched last; sequential bilateral updates only; no conclusion for branching trees, changing preferences, ties, or simultaneous updates. Publication priority remains subject to independent scrutiny.
title: Sharp quadratic bound for blocking-pair dynamics on a path
